analysis: The uniform-negative trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.505: +0.0275 over the preceding mined-negative trial (0.4775), +0.0013 over the reported 0.5037 reference, and equal to the 0.505 baseline. Category HR@10 values were Movies_and_TV 0.570, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.500, Electronics 0.390, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.560. Relative to the preceding trial, changes were +0.055, -0.020, +0.015, and +0.060, respectively. These results support uniform sampling in this configuration, but one comparison does not establish mining as the sole cause of the earlier regression. Allocated GPU time was 529.68 seconds. No held-out test results were supplied.
code_summary: Trains one independent gated SASRec per category, with 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, and dropout 0.2. A jointly trained causal attention-pooling history branch shares item embeddings and blends with Transformer features through a learned gate. Scores use normalized embeddings, a learned scale, and jointly trained item biases. Training uses a shared batch pool of up to 256 distinct uniform negatives, masking complete training histories and current targets without mining or refill. Float32 sampled-softmax cross-entropy covers up to 24 sampled transitions per history, with an eight-transition recency half-life and per-history normalization. AdamW, prefix augmentation, seed 42, fixed validation candidates, and validation-based checkpoint selection remain. Prediction strictly loads exactly one selected checkpoint per category, with reload score parity checked; no ensembles or auxiliary fitted scorers are used.
